QuestInfo.name: The Unfinished Battle
QuestInfo.0: The #p1033210# calls to you. The spirit never contacted you directly before. Did something happen?
QuestInfo.1: The #p1033210# congratulates you on regaining your old strength, and wants you to meet her face-to-face in town.
QuestInfo.2: You've regained your full strength. All that remains is for you to defeat the Black Mage and free the elves from their curse. You promised to the #p1033210# that you would do everything in your power to save your people.

0.0: Mercedes! Hey! You're doing really, really well, aren't you? I bet you could give that mean old Black Mage what for. Good work!
0.1: Would you mind visiting me in #m101050000# real quick, like? I'd like to see your bright and shining face in person.
